The program was rejected because of the word "input" in the comments; the topology is otherwise sound. The `"input"` construct appeared only in the PARAMS and section comments, and I've reworded them. I also removed a dead `m1.vgs if False else` expression and a redundant `C2` assignment.

The plan is unchanged. A unity-gain Sallen-Key stage (Q≈1) plus an RC pole at fc forms a 3rd-order Butterworth. That gives about 60 dB at 10·fc and no peaking. Power is about 99 µW, inside the 140 µW budget.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # diff pair L
    "itail": (45e-6, 25e-6, 62e-6),  # OTA tail current
    "C2":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 3e-12),   # SK grounded cap
    "qsk":   (0.98, 0.85, 1.1),      # biquad Q (Butterworth-3 -> 1.0)
    "R3":    (50e3, 20e3, 150e3),    # output RC pole resistor
    "kf":    (1.0, 0.85, 1.2),       # frequency trim
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    fc = 1.5e6
    wc = 2 * PI * fc * p["kf"]

    # current budget
    imax = 140e-6 / vdd * 0.92 - iref
    itail = min(p["itail"], imax)
    i1 = itail / 2

    # OTA sizing (5T, NMOS pair, PMOS mirror)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.22)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, i1, vds=0.95)
    m3d = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, i1, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, itail, vds=0.22)

    # SK biquad passives (unity gain, equal R)
    Q = p["qsk"]
    C2 = p["C2"]
    C1 = 4 * Q * Q * C2
    R = 1.0 / (wc * 2 * Q * C2)
    C2_place = max(C2 - 0.5 * m1.cgg, 0.1e-15)

    # output RC pole at fc; CL is part of it
    R3 = p["R3"]
    Ct = 1.0 / (wc * R3)
    C3 = max(Ct - cl, 0.1e-15)
    Ct = C3 + cl

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("R1", "vin", "nx", R)
    n.R("R2", "nx", "ny", R)
    n.C("C1", "nx", "vo1", C1)
    n.C("C2", "ny", "vss", C2_place)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "nd1", "ny", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vo1", "vo1", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd1", "nd1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vo1", "nd1", "vdd", "vdd", m3d)
    n.R("R3", "vo1", "vout", R3)
    n.C("C3", "vout", "vss", C3)

    # analytic prediction (nodal solve incl. OTA gm, Go, Co)
    gm = m1.gm
    Go = m1.gds + m3d.gds
    Co = m1.cdd + m3d.cdd
    Cy = C2_place + 0.5 * m1.cgg
    f = np.logspace(3, 8, 3000)
    mag = np.zeros_like(f)
    G = 1.0 / R; G3 = 1.0 / R3
    for k, fk in enumerate(f):
        s = 1j * 2 * PI * fk
        A = np.array([
            [-2 * G - s * C1, G, s * C1, 0],
            [G, -G - s * Cy, 0, 0],
            [s * C1, gm, -gm - Go - s * Co - s * C1 - G3, G3],
            [0, 0, G3, -G3 - s * Ct]], dtype=complex)
        b = np.array([-G * 1.0, 0, 0, 0], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(A, b)
        mag[k] = 20 * np.log10(abs(v[3]) + 1e-30)
    g0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < g0 - 3.0)[0]
    if len(idx):
        i = idx[0]
        x0, x1 = np.log10(f[i - 1]), np.log10(f[i])
        y0, y1 = mag[i - 1], mag[i]
        fc_p = 10 ** (x0 + (g0 - 3.0 - y0) * (x1 - x0) / (y1 - y0))
    else:
        fc_p = f[-1]
    peak = max(float(np.max(mag) - g0), 0.0)
    fs = 10 * fc_p
    att = g0 - float(np.interp(np.log10(fs), np.log10(f), mag))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cy / (C1 + Cy) + Co))

    return n, {"gain_db": float(g0), "fc": float(fc_p), "atten_db": float(att),
               "peaking_db": peak, "power": power, "gbw": gbw}
```
